dedupe_keys.name: advanced driver assistance system adas equipped two vehicle data for central ohio

description: Advanced Driver Assistance System (ADAS)-Equipped Two-Vehicle Data for Central Ohio is a dataset listed in data.transportation.gov (U.S. DOT open data portal), an open data portal of the U.S. Department of Transportation under the section "Automobiles", published or maintained by Federal Highway Adminsitration. Dataset contains two subject vehicles’ trajectory data connected in naturalistic traffic conditions in central Ohio. Instrumented subject vehicles were either a discreet or readily-identifiable ADAS-equipped vehicle with SAE L2 capabilities. Dataset also contains trajectories for adjacent vehicles in traffic (observed by the subject vehicles’ onboard sensors). Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Automobiles". It has 67 columns, among them dim_y_av, dim_x_av, lane_id_av, speed_av, road_origin_y_m, map_origin_y. The portal shows 2023-08-23 as the last data update. Attribution given: Federal Highway Adminsitration. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-usdot-data-transportation-gov-portal.
